activity.phase: Required human-readable string describing the current operation or deferral. Running and deferred are incomplete passes, not successful attempts; they preserve the previous completed result.

product_archive.failure_count.meaning: One when the latest collector or Borg worker attempt failed; zero following a successful attempt. Each worker emits its own status.

product_archive.capture_gap_count.meaning: Count of explicitly recorded unrecoverable or potentially incomplete capture intervals. Persists across restarts and archival; requires operator acknowledgement to clear.

product_archive.buffer_bytes.meaning: Allocated bytes of committed live-feed payload files plus their SQLite indexes in open and sealed buffers. Excludes temporary writes, small control files, and filesystem directory overhead.

product_archive.repository_bytes.meaning: Allocated repository bytes; collector status reports live-feeds, store status reports cycles. Includes Borg metadata and uncompacted segments.

product_archive.progress_reference_unix_.meaning: Unix timestamp of the last fully successful worker pass, or the first tracked attempt if none has succeeded. Running, deferred, and failed passes do not advance it. A successful store pass includes both repositories and retention; an unchanged publication is a successful check.
